verdict.rationale: The Search API docs claim 'real-time data' with 'advanced filtering' and 'real-time web search results' with domain filtering, which supports the freshness side of the story. The evidence never names date-range or recency filter parameters, and only domain filtering is explicitly listed. missing for 10: explicit date-range and recency filter parameters, documentation of index update frequency or freshness guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
